id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataItem.description:
Read-only. The wrapped data object for the current row.
Property `obj` is an object containing data for the current row.

children.description: Read-only. The elements to render as children of this element.

columnProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the column to which the cell belongs.

gridProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the grid to which the cell belongs.

defaultStyle.description:
The styles to apply to all chips that don't match any values in
[#groupingOptions.valuesToStyles](ChipsCellGroupingOptions#valuesToStyles).
Defaults to the style of a primary {@link UiSdlButton}.

groupingOptions.description: Options for how chips should be grouped, styled, and arranged based on their values.

outlined.description:
If true, the chips will be rendered with transparent backgrounds. They'll
still have borders that are colored according to {@link ChipStyle}.

fieldPath.description:
[#dataItem.obj](UiSdlDataGridDataItem#obj) can be an array of either strings
or {@link Obj}s.

  - If it's an array of {@link Obj}s, this field must be provided to extract
    the display value from each {@link Obj}.
  - If it's an array of strings, this field should be empty.

collapseThreshold.description:
The maximum number of chips to display before the rest are hidden and a button
to reveal #numChipsToReveal more chips is shown. If not specified, all chips
will be displayed at all times.

numChipsToReveal.description:
The number of chips to reveal when the `+{n} more` button is clicked. If not
specified, the `+{n} more` button will reveal all chips.

title:
Custom grid cell that will render an array of values in the form of individual
chip/pill shapes to make distinguishing items in lists easier.

Each chip can trigger an action when clicked. To enable this, specify a
{@link UiSdlDataGridDataSpecColumnFieldSetting#actionSuffix} for the column
rendering the cell.
name: ChipsCell
